errors: choice: `navigation` is not an attribute of choice. It takes: prompt, shuffle, min-choices, max-choices, response-processing, upper-bound, options. `navigation` configures the whole activity, so it goes after the items list rather than inside an item: items [ … ] navigation "…" {}.
